top_5_topics.title: Unified Pension Scheme (UPS) and Fiscal Implications
top_5_topics.gs_paper: GS Paper III - Indian Economy and Issues Relating to Planning, Mobilization of Resources
top_5_topics.summary: The Union Cabinet approved the Unified Pension Scheme (UPS), offering a guaranteed pension to central government employees. It combines features of the National Pension System (NPS) and Old Pension Scheme (OPS).
key_takeaways: Guarantees 50% of the average basic pay drawn over the last 12 months prior to superannuation for minimum 25 years of service.
Requires a minimum of 10 years of service for a proportionate pension.
Balancing employee social security with long-term fiscal prudence for state exchequers.

top_5_topics.title: High-Level Committee Recommendations on 'One Nation, One Election'
top_5_topics.gs_paper: GS Paper II - Indian Constitution, Polity, and Governance
top_5_topics.summary: The Cabinet accepted the Ram Nath Kovind panel report recommending simultaneous elections for the Lok Sabha and State Legislative Assemblies as a first step, followed by local body elections within 100 days.
key_takeaways: Requires constitutional amendments to Articles 83, 172, and 356.
Aims to reduce election expenditure, policy paralysis, and governance disruption.
Concerns raised regarding federalism, regional party visibility, and constitutional feasibility.

top_5_topics.title: Great Nicobar Island Strategic Infrastructure Project and Ecological Concerns
top_5_topics.gs_paper: GS Paper III - Environment, Ecology, and Biodiversity
top_5_topics.summary: The ₹72,000-crore mega project includes an International Container Transshipment Terminal, airport, power plant, and township on Great Nicobar Island, drawing scrutiny over environmental clearance.
key_takeaways: Strategic significance for Indo-Pacific maritime security and proximity to Malacca Strait.
Threats to the endemic Shompen and Nicobarese vulnerable tribal groups.
Impact on biodiversity hotspots, coral reefs, and primary rainforest cover.

top_5_topics.title: NISAR Mission (NASA-ISRO Synthetic Aperture Radar) Progress
top_5_topics.gs_paper: GS Paper III - Science & Technology (Space Technology)
top_5_topics.summary: The joint Earth-observing mission between NASA and ISRO nears launch readiness, designed to map the entire globe every 12 days using dual-frequency radar.
key_takeaways: First satellite to use dual frequencies (L-band by NASA, S-band by ISRO) for earth observation.
Will monitor glacier dynamics, land surface deformation, forest biomass, and natural hazard warnings.

top_5_topics.title: Implementation of India-EFTA Trade and Economic Partnership Agreement (TEPA)
top_5_topics.gs_paper: GS Paper II - Bilateral, Regional and Global Groupings involving India
top_5_topics.summary: Progress continues on operationalizing the historic pact between India and the European Free Trade Association (Iceland, Liechtenstein, Norway, Switzerland).
key_takeaways: Includes a target of $100 billion investment commitment into India over 15 years.
Enhances trade in services, intellectual property rights, and reduction of tariff barriers.
Sets a benchmark for India's future Free Trade Agreements (FTAs) with Western economies.
